domain-information: A garden coordinator reviews new applications for available garden plots.
A garden coordinator schedules a maintenance day for volunteers to clean the plots.
A garden coordinator updates the plot assignment list after a member leaves.
A garden coordinator compiles an end-of-season report for the city’s urban agriculture program.
A city resident signs up for a garden plot to grow vegetables.
A city resident participates in a seed exchange with other members.
A city resident the types of crops planted in their plot for seasonal planning.
A city resident makes a harvest donation to the community’s harvest share program.
A city resident reports a pest issue to the coordinator for assistance.
A city resident maintains a compost.
A city resident participates in a garden fair.
A volunteer participates in maintenance day to clean a registered plot.
A volunteer helps collect compostable materials.
A volunteer promotes an upcoming garden fair.
A garden coordinator carries out a garden inspection to ensure safety and environmental compliance.
A garden coordinator provides funding for new garden tools to a city resident.
